source:
@@U03406@@
She frightens off all thoughts of beauty and delight; and where beauty and delight are, let her appear and they've taken flight.

@@U03408@@
These cousins so delicate and dainty I find no less suspicious; for behind their cheeks as red as roses I expect a sudden metamorphosis.

@@U03410@@
Come on, give it a try, why don’t you! You've lots to choose from. Take your pick. With a little bit of luck you'll snatch the prize! What’s all this lascivious litany! As a lover you're a washout, strutting around like the cock of the walk! Ah! You see? There! That got him! He’s mixing now, joining the dance. Slowly, now, one by one— gently, gently, when your turn comes— let your masks fall. Show him the unvarnished truth.

@@U03412@@
Here’s the prettiest one of all!

@@U03413@@
(Embracing her.)

@@U03414@@
Ah! What's this! A withered old broomstick!

@@U03415@@
(Seizing another.)

@@U03416@@
And this?
translation:
@@U03406@@
她吓跑了所有关于美丽和欢乐的想法；哪里有美丽和欢乐，只要她出现，它们就会飞翔。

@@U03408@@
这些表兄弟是如此精致和精致，我发现同样令人怀疑。因为他们的脸颊后面像玫瑰一样红，我预计他们会突然变态。

@@U03410@@
来吧，尝试一下，为什么不呢！你有很多选择。随你挑选。只要有一点点运气，你就能获得奖品！这些淫荡的废话到底是什么啊！作为一个情人，你是一个失败者，像公鸡一样昂首阔步！啊!你看？那里！那抓住了他！他现在正在混音，加入舞蹈。慢慢地，现在，一个接一个地——轻轻地，轻轻地，当轮到你的时候——让你的面具落下。向他展示不加掩饰的真相。

@@U03412@@
这是其中最漂亮的一个！

@@U03413@@
（拥抱她。）

@@U03414@@
啊！这是什么啊！枯萎的老扫帚！

@@U03415@@
（抓住另一个。）

@@U03416@@
还有这个？
